templates.title: Mino
templates.name: mino
templates.description: A self-hosted Markdown notebook with an AI agent that files, links and retrieves your notes. API and dashboard in one container.
templates.note: Deployed from the repository, so updates are a pull plus a redeploy. The dashboard is served by the same container at port 3000.

env.name: MINO_CONNECTION_MODE
env.label: Connection mode
env.description: relay reaches the server through the managed relay without opening a port; open-port exposes it directly.

env.name: MINO_PORT_BIND
env.label: Bind address
env.description: 127.0.0.1 keeps the container private to this host; 0.0.0.0 publishes it on every interface.

env.name: MINO_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL
env.label: Public server URL
env.description: Only for open-port mode: the URL clients use to reach this server, e.g. https://notes.example.com.

env.name: MINO_RELAY_URL
env.label: Relay URL
env.description: Only for relay mode: the managed relay the server dials out to.
